name: Axi Coder (axi-model-gateway contract alias)
summary: Axi Coder development workbench with a grandfathered axi-model-gateway provider contract alias at the same physical path.

entrypoints.purpose: Hosted and desktop React application entrypoint.
Axi Coder capability and consumer contract surface.
Provider profile, credential reference, and model-routing contract.
Tauri desktop runtime and native command surface.

troubleshooting.symptom: Hosted dashboard starts but native commands are unavailable.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: The browser-hosted mode is running without the Tauri runtime.
troubleshooting.resolution: Use AXI_APP_BASE / AXI_APP_PORT and the browser-safe fallback; use pnpm tauri dev for native command verification.

troubleshooting.symptom: Provider requests fail before reaching the configured model.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: Provider profile, credential reference, or local proxy routing is invalid.
troubleshooting.resolution: Run the provider profile tests and inspect the local diagnostic category; never store the raw API key in SQLite or Git.

decisions.notes: Axi Coder is the actual product at this path. axi-model-gateway is a grandfathered contract alias, not a second project; see ADR-007.

active: Keep the completion panel wired to generated workspace evidence.
Keep the Mac desktop, hosted browser, and mobile companion contracts aligned.
Keep provider routing and credential references separate from the Axi Coder product identity.
